review.eventDescription: One App Store customer review (row keys review_id, app_id, country, rating = 1-5, title, text, author, review_date, is_edited, developer_response, developer_response_date, url): $4 per 1,000 reviews. Not charged: app rows (App Store rating, rating count, star histogram), status rows, reviews removed by minRating, maxRating, sinceDate or requireText, a review Apple lists on two storefronts (delivered once), apps with no reviews, ids or names that match nothing, failed jobs, bad input. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. Apple answers 10 reviews per request; every delivered review is a written review. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd), never above it.
